note: Event targets and scoring from the September 2026 events (one division), and Newms's energy income as editable defaults. Energy per stage comes from data/bosses.json; drop tables and Arena league points are in event-scoring.json. perChase (perBoss for relic bosses) is how many of each event run in one chase, from the Grimnall Chase schedule (October 2026).

events.name: Relic Boss
events.scoring: Points for every item dropped, by stars and rarity: 30 to 60 for a 3-star item, 40 to 100 for 4 stars, 230 to 450 for 5 stars and 800 to 2,500 for 6 stars. Two items drop per run.

events.name: Accessory Hunt (clan boss)
events.scoring: Scored like the Relic Boss events: points per item by stars and rarity, two items per run.

events.name: Crest Bosses
events.scoring: 1 point per Rare, 10 per Epic and 100 per Legendary item dropped.

events.name: Omnissi (Essence)
events.scoring: 1 point per Rare, 10 per Epic and 100 per Legendary item dropped.

events.name: Campaign Rush
events.scoring: A fixed score per battle by difficulty, the same on every stage.

events.name: Arena Rush
events.scoring: Points for every arena battle, more for a win and more in higher leagues: from 40 per win and 20 per loss in Bronze 1 up to 150 and 70 in Gold 4. Some days score double.

events.name: Gear Up
events.scoring: Points for upgrading gear to +5, +10, +15 and +20, more for higher-star gear.

events.name: Invoker Summon
events.scoring: Points for every summon item used, plus points for each Invoker pulled by rarity. Chroma pulls score double.

events.name: Titan Summon
events.scoring: Points for every orb used, plus points for each Titan pulled by rarity.

events.name: Invoker Power Up
events.scoring: Points for levels gained, ascensions, awakening levels and codices used.

events.name: Titan Power Up
events.scoring: Points for Titan levels, ascensions, empowerments and prisms.
